text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. EllisDon Corporation is constructing two towers with a total of 400 rental and condominium units connected by an eight-story podium with one level on underground parking and a row of townhomes along Cooperage Street at 409 Front Street East. In addition, a five-storey training and education centre will also be constructed on the subject site. The site encompasses the entire block bounded by Front Street East to the north, Cooperage Street to the east, Mill Street to the south and Cherry Street to the west. Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on May 19, 2021, approved the temporary closure of west sidewalk on Cooperage Street, between Front Street East and Mill Road, from May 20, 2021 to May 30, 2022. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the continuation of the closure of the west sidewalk on Cooperage Street, between Front Street East and Mill Road, from January 27, 2023 to September 30, 2024. 2. Directed the applicant to pressure wash or sweep (weather permitting) the construction site and adjacent sidewalks and roadways daily, or more frequently as needed to be cleared of any construction debris and made safe. 3. Directed the applicant to continue to clearly consult and communicate all construction, parking and road occupancy impacts with local Business Improvement Areas and resident associations in advance of any physical road modifications. 4. Directed the applicant to continue to install appropriate signage and converging mirrors to ensure that pedestrians, cyclists and motorists safety is considered at all times. 5.
